$comment: Local ONNX models of the worker (design D7, docs/models.md). Fetched by scripts/fetch-models.ts from the pinned URL, verified by sha256, never committed (.gitignore). Sources: research/libs-media.md sections 3-5.

models.name: nsfw
models.upstream: Marqo/nsfw-image-detection-384 (timm vit_tiny_patch16_384, 5.6 M params), revision 0c26ec22111b83f106d72a55f611ec35962bcb65, Apache-2.0; byte-reproducible ONNX export (opset 17) by ICIJ

output.name: logits
output.meaning: raw logits; softmax outside; index 0 = NSFW, index 1 = SFW

models.name: face
models.upstream: YuNet 2023mar, OpenCV Zoo (from ShiqiYu/libfacedetection.train), (c) 2020 Shiqi Yu, MIT

input.name: input
input.layout: NCHW float32, BGR, 0-255, no normalisation, squash-resized

output.meaning: per stride s in {8, 16, 32}: (640/s)^2 cells; score = sqrt(cls * obj); bbox = (cx, cy offsets in cells, log w, log h) * s; 5 landmarks; NMS (IoU 0.3) outside
